title: Three Three Six
style: Progressive trance with slow hypnotic 136 BPM drive, shamanic drum pulse, deep didgeridoo duet motifs, tribal hand percussion, rolling sub tension, and circular phrasing; verses stay sparse with drone call-and-response between twin didgeridoos, pre-drop strips to drums and breathy overtone textures, chorus opens into layered rhythmic chants and pitched didge harmonics. Whispered ad-libs, wide stereo delay throws, reverse swells into each transition, crisp low-end and earthy, ceremonial mix, trance, didgeridoo, slow, hypnotic
